posts.title: Concept: Volatility Drag
posts.description: Volatility Drag If you lose 50% of your capital in one year, you’ll need to achieve a 100% return the next year, just to get even. This asymmetry is the cause of the “Volatility drag” - one unit loss will hurt your long-term gains more than one unit gain.
